about: RSI-01 activity atlas (docs/plans/rsi-01.md). Gaps: language capabilities RoboLang lacks, each with the benchmark tasks that show it. Activities: what robots are expected to do, with dated, checkable forecasts.

gaps.name: Repetition without a fixed bound: loops, retry until it works, schedules, event streams
gaps.scope_note: N4 (2026-10-29): the orchestrator repeats tasks. First to revisit: continuous work is repetition

gaps.name: Clock readings and times of day
Waiting for an incoming message, or confirming delivery
Arithmetic, counting and text built from values
Actions beyond move, grasp, place, inspect, wait, communicate, measure: open, charge, set a device
Staying inside or outside a region while moving
gaps.scope_note: `in_region`, `no_go_region` reserved (E211); needed by H4 (safety case G2)

gaps.name: Force limits and gentle handling
gaps.scope_note: needed by H4 (safety case G2, H05)

gaps.name: Several robots acting at the same time
Choosing objects or robots at run time
gaps.scope_note: D4 deferred `detect`; D5 ranks it by the atlas

gaps.name: A different end state counts as done
Limits and reactions that depend on people nearby: slow, stop or yield when a person is within a distance
gaps.scope_note: from foresight pass 1, no benchmark task yet

gaps.name: Acting on a predicted future: a person's next move, the outcome of a plan, time to failure
gaps.scope_note: from foresight pass 1, no benchmark task yet

gaps.name: Teaching the robot a new skill, object or route by demonstration or correction, then using it by name
gaps.scope_note: from foresight pass 1, no benchmark task yet

activities.name: Humanoid tote handling in fulfilment centres
activities.basis: DC Velocity (2026-10-26): Agility's Digit has moved over 100,000 totes at GXO's Flowery Branch, Georgia site under a robots-as-a-service contract, and GXO adds Statesville NC and Lebanon TN from early 2027. Agility's CEO calls GXO the first customer to run Digit in live operations under a commercial agreement.
requests: Move every tote from the inbound conveyor to the outbound conveyor until the shift ends.
Move the totes on the inbound conveyor to cart 3, then tell the shift lead how many you moved.
If you cannot grasp a tote after three tries, leave it and flag it to the lead, then carry on with the next one.

forecast.claim: Agility Robotics, or another humanoid vendor, publicly names at least five customers with paid humanoid tote-handling operations by 2028-06-30.

activities.name: Autonomous trailer and container unloading
activities.basis: The Robot Report (2026-11-06): Boston Dynamics unveiled Stretch Gen 2, rated up to 1,000 cases/hour, and says the Stretch fleet is already running at multiple customer sites (over 100,000 operating hours and tens of millions of boxes). The article names no customers.
requests: Unload trailer 4 onto conveyor B and stop when the trailer is empty.
If two cases come up in one pick, put the extra one back on the stack and carry on.
Tell the dock supervisor how many cases you unloaded from trailer 4.

forecast.claim: Boston Dynamics or a customer publicly reports at least 500 Stretch robots in operation by 2028-12-31.

activities.name: Parts sequencing for the assembly line
activities.basis: The Robot Report (2026-06-29): BMW is deploying Figure 03 at Plant Spartanburg to pick unsorted parts from large containers into a sequencing trolley, after an 11-month Figure 02 deployment there that supported more than 30,000 X3 vehicles. The article gives no Figure 03 unit count or duration.
requests: Pick the parts for the next car from the bins into the sequencing trolley in order, then move the trolley to the collection point.
Sort whatever parts are left in container 2 into the trolley, and message the tugger when it is full.
Keep sequencing until the end of the shift.

forecast.claim: BMW or Figure publicly confirms Figure humanoids in production logistics work at a second BMW plant by 2028-06-30.

activities.name: Humanoid-to-tugger handoff of totes in a car plant
activities.basis: Agility's press release (2026-02-19): Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada signed a robots-as-a-service agreement for Digit after a successful pilot, for manufacturing, supply-chain and logistics work (robot count and metrics not disclosed). The BMW Figure 03 task ends with an automated tugger train or transport robot carrying the parts to assembly.
requests: Put the tote on the tugger cart when it reaches the handoff point; if a worker is in the lane, wait.
Hold the tote at the handoff point and place it as soon as the tugger reports it has docked.
Use whichever tugger is nearest the handoff point.

forecast.claim: At least one automaker other than Toyota and BMW publicly reports humanoid tote or parts handling in a plant under a commercial agreement by 2027-12-31.

activities.name: Store shelf scanning and out-of-stock reporting
activities.basis: The Shelby Report (2026-09-21): Simbe announced more than 3,000 autonomous units under contract across more than 75 retail banners in nearly a dozen countries; the robots digitise shelves (availability, location, prices, promotions) and work alongside other sensors.
requests: Scan aisle 5 and tell the store lead which products are out of stock.
Every morning at 6, scan all aisles and report any price that does not match its label.
If the aisle is blocked by a pallet, skip it and tell the lead which aisle you missed.

forecast.claim: Simbe announces at least 4,500 contracted units by 2028-09-30.

activities.name: Fry-station cooking in restaurant kitchens
activities.basis: Fast Casual (2026-03-26): Miso Robotics' Flippy Fry Station has produced over 5 million fried baskets in live restaurants across seven US states, including White Castle, Jack in the Box and Wing Zone sites.
requests: Fry a basket of fries for 3 minutes, then tip it into the hot-holding tray.
Set the fryer to 175 degrees and start the next basket when the oil reads 175.
If the fries come out too dark, discard that basket and tell the kitchen lead.

forecast.claim: Miso Robotics reports at least 15 million cumulative fried baskets, or Flippy in at least 15 US states, by 2028-03-31.

activities.name: Hospital delivery and supply runs for nurses and pharmacy
activities.basis: The Robot Report (2026): Diligent's Moxi (acquired by Serve Robotics in January 2026) runs in more than 25 US hospitals; Children's Hospital Los Angeles reports over 40,000 deliveries and 16,000 hours of work and has grown from two to three robots. Moxi 2.0 rollout was announced on 2026-08-17.
requests: Take the medication from the pharmacy to room 412 and wait for the nurse to confirm before leaving.
Open the supply closet, take the IV kit to the ward, and tell the charge nurse it is there.
Every hour, bring the lab samples from the ward to the lab.

forecast.claim: Serve Robotics or Diligent reports Moxi in at least 50 US hospitals by 2028-06-30.

activities.name: Companion robot in dementia and memory care
activities.basis: UC Davis Health (2026-05-28): a yearlong, non-interventional study of Andromeda Robotics' humanoid companion Abi with up to 25 residents in the memory care neighbourhood of Eskaton Village, Carmichael. Abi holds conversations, plays music and runs shared activities; the study is about companionship, not physical care.
requests: At 3 pm play music for Mrs Lee in the lounge, and stay until the song ends.
Stay with Mr Kim until he falls asleep, and tell the nurse if he gets upset.
If a resident asks for the nurse, send the message and wait for the nurse to answer.

forecast.claim: A US senior-living operator publicly announces a paid rollout of companion robots to at least 10 communities by 2029-06-30.

activities.name: Laundry folding in the home
activities.basis: arXiv 2511.14759 (Physical Intelligence, 2025-11-18): the pi*0.6 model, trained with offline RL and on-robot experience (RECAP), folds laundry in real homes, assembles boxes and makes espresso, with more than double the throughput and about half the failure rate on hard tasks. A research result, not a product.
requests: Fold the laundry in the basket: towels on the left shelf, shirts on the right.
If a piece has a stain, put it in the wash pile instead.
Keep folding until the basket is empty, then tell me how many pieces you folded.

forecast.claim: A company announces paying customers using a household laundry-folding robot without remote operators by 2029-06-30.

activities.name: General household chores by a home humanoid
activities.basis: heise (2026-05-08): 1X plans first NEO deliveries to US private customers by end of 2026, price from 20,000 USD or about 500 USD/month, with a first-year batch of 10,000 reportedly sold out; early units help with internal logistics in the factory. No source I opened confirms robots working in customer homes.
requests: At 8 pm vacuum the living room unless someone is in it.
Put every toy on the floor into the toy box, but stay out of the nursery.
After dinner, load the dishwasher and start it.

forecast.claim: 1X publicly confirms at least 1,000 NEO units delivered to customer homes by 2028-06-30.

activities.name: Autonomous gauge and thermal inspection rounds
activities.basis: The Robot Report (2026-01-21): Boston Dynamics' Orbit 5.1 lets operators author gauge-reading and thermal inspection actions for Spot, and Spot Cam 2 adds a radiometric thermal camera. The article names no customer for these features, so no named site is confirmed.
requests: Read the gauge on pump 3 and tell me if it is above 6 bar.
Walk the boiler-room route every hour and report any gauge that is out of range.
Take a thermal image of motor 7 and flag it if it is above 80 degrees.

forecast.claim: A named industrial customer publicly reports routine use of Spot automated gauge reading by 2027-12-31.

activities.name: Inspection that learns the facility
activities.basis: Boston Dynamics blog: AIVI-Learning (5S audits, pallet counting, sight-glass levels, gauge reading) went live on Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 for enrolled customers on 2026-04-08, and is 'designed to continuously learn and adapt' to the facility, with data shared with Boston Dynamics. No customer is named.
requests: Learn what a normal pallet count looks like in bay 3 and alert me when it differs.
Add this valve to your inspection route.
Count the pallets in bay 3 and tell me the number.

forecast.claim: Boston Dynamics names at least three customers using AIVI-Learning by 2027-12-31.

activities.name: Security patrol that reacts to people
activities.basis: The Robot Report (2026-01-21): Orbit 5.1 adds a security patrol mission type for Spot. When Spot detects a person it pauses, switches on lights, captures PTZ, panoramic and thermal images, triggers an alert and resumes its path. No customer is named.
requests: Patrol the north perimeter after 10 pm; if you see a person, stop, take a picture and alert security, then continue.
Stay out of the lab corridor during the patrol.
Patrol the yard every two hours until 6 am.

forecast.claim: Boston Dynamics or a security firm publicly names a customer running Spot autonomous security patrols by 2028-03-31.

activities.name: Fence-free humanoid work beside people
activities.basis: Agility says Digit v5 is designed to work beside people without safety fencing ('cooperative safety'), with early-customer deployments from December 2026; it has published no certification for unguarded operation (2026-08-10 article). ISO 25785-1 (dynamically stable industrial robots) was still a working draft as of early 2026, with zoning, speed reduction near people and force limits expected; ratification was estimated at late 2026 to 2027.
requests: Work in aisle 3, but slow to 0.2 m/s when a person is within 2 metres and stop when one is within 1 metre.
Never enter the red zone while a person is in it.
Hand the tote to Ana without pushing harder than the contact limit.

forecast.claim: ISO 25785-1 is published as an International Standard by 2028-12-31.

activities.name: Construction-site layout printing
activities.basis: Dusty Robotics' site: the FieldPrinter prints full-size BIM layout on jobsite floors, with over 300 million square feet printed in more than 1,000 buildings and general contractors such as DPR, Skanska and McCarthy named (vendor claims); available in North America only.
requests: Print the wall layout for level 3 and stay inside the marked zone.
Print the layout for all trades on this floor, then stop.
If something blocks the floor, go around it and tell me where it is.

forecast.claim: Dusty Robotics announces FieldPrinter availability outside North America by 2028-12-31.

activities.name: Greenhouse fruit harvesting
activities.basis: FreshPlaza (2026): Tokuiten's suction-type cherry-tomato robot has been in full production use on its own 2,000 m2 farm in Aichi, Japan since 2026-05-25, picking about half of what one human picker does; a 1-hectare facility with six robots is scheduled for March 2027. The company seeks pilot partners.
requests: Harvest the ripe cherry tomatoes in row 4 and put them in the crate.
Harvest on Tuesday and Thursday evenings.
Pick gently: do not squeeze the fruit.

forecast.claim: Tokuiten's 1-hectare, six-robot facility is operating by 2027-12-31.

activities.name: Robotic EV charging in garages and depots
activities.basis: Electrek (2026-02-23): overhead-rail charging robots are already deployed in garages across multiple Chinese cities, and Beijing plans 1,000 mobile charging robots in 150 car parks; Western deployments are still in pilot. No site is named.
requests: Charge the white van in bay 6 until it reaches 80 percent.
Plug in the next car in the queue when its driver asks for a charge.
Unplug the car in bay 2 and return to the dock.

forecast.claim: At least one US or EU operator reports robotic EV charging in daily commercial service at three or more sites by 2028-06-30.

activities.name: Scheduled autonomous floor cleaning
activities.basis: Robotics Tomorrow (2026-04-07): Brain Corp says more than 40,000 robots are deployed across six continents; BrainOS Clean 2.0 for Tennant floor cleaners adds SelfPath AI (no manual route training), schedule-based operation and automatic charging, with fleet-wide rollout planned for May 2026.
requests: Clean the lobby every night at 11 pm, then go back to the dock to charge.
Do not clean the wet-floor zone.
If an aisle is blocked, clean the next one and tell the supervisor.

forecast.claim: Brain Corp reports at least 75,000 deployed robots by 2028-12-31.

activities.name: Mixed robot teams on one workflow
activities.basis: Google DeepMind (2026-07-30): Gemini Robotics ER 2 adds the ability for different types of robots to communicate and work together on workflows one robot could not do alone. ER 2 is in Google AI Studio and private preview; the action models are for early-access partners. No customer deployment is described.
requests: Have the humanoid carry the shelf to the dock while the AMR clears the path.
Send whichever robot is closest to the spill.
Tell me when both robots have finished.

forecast.claim: A named customer publicly reports a multi-robot workflow orchestrated by Gemini Robotics ER by 2028-12-31.

activities.name: Multi-vendor fleet interoperability
activities.basis: The Robot Report (2026-11-03): A3 published ISO 21423:2026 for communication among industrial mobile robots from different suppliers (location, speed, direction, condition, tasking, availability), including machines, ERP tools, lifts and doors. I opened no source on live multi-vendor sites.
requests: Send the AMR to the pickup point, and place the tote only after it reports it has arrived.
Use the nearest free robot, whichever vendor made it.
Let only one robot into the aisle at a time.

forecast.claim: At least three robot vendors publicly claim ISO 21423 conformance by 2028-06-30.

activities.name: Task-oriented object handover to a person
activities.basis: arXiv 2602.05760 (ETH Zurich, HRI 2026): AFT-Handover uses LLM affordance reasoning to present an object so the person can use it next (for example a tool handle), shown on legged manipulators; a user study preferred it over the prior state of the art.
requests: Hand the screwdriver to Ana handle first, and let go only when she has it.
Pass me the wrench, then wait until I say I am done.
Hand the part to whoever is at station 2.

forecast.claim: A commercial robot's SDK or manual documents a task-oriented handover feature by 2029-06-30.

activities.name: Following ambiguous and corrective instructions during shared work
activities.basis: arXiv 2602.14551 (Kato et al., 2026): a humanoid maps ambiguous, corrective instructions in collaborative assembly to action targets with VLM correction models; real-world object fixation succeeded 66.7%, corrective tool selection 75%. The page does not say the robot asks clarifying questions.
requests: Hold the panel here while I fix it, and let go when I say release.
No, the other tool: the one on the left.
If you are not sure which part I mean, ask me.

forecast.claim: A commercial robot SDK documents a clarification or correction mechanism for natural-language instructions by 2028-12-31.

activities.name: Robot-team structural assembly with symbolic replanning
activities.basis: arXiv 2601.00978 (Chen and Deng, 2026-01-02): VLM agents check RGB-D views against design specs to build a symbolic state (97% state synthesis accuracy), and a planner assigns tasks across multiple robots and replans only when the observed state diverges, for a 27-component timber frame under human interventions.
requests: Assemble the timber wall frame: fix each stud only after the previous one is checked.
If a stud is missing, replan with the ones you have and tell me.
Check every installed component against the drawing and report any that is wrong.

forecast.claim: A construction firm announces a paid pilot of multi-robot structural assembly with VLM planning by 2029-06-30.

activities.name: Anticipating a coworker's next movement
activities.basis: arXiv 2604.03065 (Bulanti, Carfi, Mastrogiovanni, 2026-04-03): MA-HERP jointly predicts human movements and actions for collaboration; a preliminary evaluation uses neural models trained on musculoskeletal simulations of reaching, and reports speed compatible with online use. No real robot is described.
requests: Hand over the part at the point where the worker's hand will be.
Move the tray only once the worker is about to reach for the bin.
Slow down if the worker is likely to step into your path.

forecast.claim: A robot vendor publicly documents human-motion prediction in a shipping safety or collaboration feature by 2029-06-30.

activities.name: Checking a plan with a world model before acting
activities.basis: arXiv 2606.13672 (WEAVER, Jain et al., 2026-06-11): a world model predicts future latents and rewards; its simulated outcomes correlate with real-world success at rho 0.87, and test-time planning with it improved real-world success by 14%.
requests: Before you place the glass, check that it will probably succeed; if not, ask me.
Plan both routes in your head and take the safer one.
If the predicted success is below 90 percent, do not start.

forecast.claim: A major robot foundation-model provider (Google, NVIDIA, Physical Intelligence or Figure) ships a world-model pre-execution check as a product feature by 2028-12-31.

history.note: Foresight pass 1 (R2): 25 sub-activities, 3 new gaps (G-PROX, G-PREDICT, G-TEACH)
